metadata.title: Clicked like a confused zombie and somehow scored a kill? Valorant, explain this madness!
metadata.description:
Me: brain offline, clicking like it’s a bug
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-headset throw
Valorant said ‘Here’s your 1 kill, just take it’
Click if your aim’s a walking disaster too!

Tap if your best kills are complete accidents too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
